intents.answer:
• 🏙️ *Featured Prestige Properties & Residences:*
• *Prestige Marigold:* Premium Villa Plots (1,200 – 2,400 sq.ft.) starting from ₹65 Lakhs at Bettenahalli, North Bangalore.
• *Prestige Southern Star:* 2, 3 & 4 BHK Luxury Residences (1,150 – 2,600 sq.ft.) starting from ₹1.15 Cr on Begur Road.
• *Prestige Thanisandra:* 2 & 3 BHK High-Rise Apartments starting from ₹88 Lakhs on Thanisandra Main Road.
• *Prestige Tech Pacific:* Grade-A Commercial Office Suites starting from ₹1.5 Cr.

_Tap 'Explore Properties' or 'Schedule Site Visit' to book a private tour!_

intents.name: pricing_plan
examples: What are the payment plans and EMI options?
What is the booking advance amount?
Send me the detailed cost sheet
What is the price of a 3 BHK unit?
Are there construction-linked payment schemes?
intents.answer:
• 💳 *Flexible Payment Schemes & Financing:*
• *Construction Linked Plan (CLP):* Milestone-based transparent payments tied to construction stages.
• *Special 10:90 Scheme:* Pay 10% advance to book, balance upon possession for eligible towers.
• *Pre-Approved Home Loans:* Tie-ups with SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Axis Bank with competitive interest rates.

_Tap 'Price & Payment Plans' to receive an instant customized cost breakdown!_

intents.answer:
• 🌟 *World-Class Amenities & Features:*
• *Grand Clubhouse:* 50,000 sq.ft. recreational clubhouse with temperature-controlled pool.
• *Sports & Fitness:* Fully equipped gymnasium, badminton courts, squash court, and yoga pavilion.
• *Green Spaces:* 70%+ open landscaped gardens, reflexology park, and children's play areas.
• *Smart Infrastructure:* 3-tier security, EV vehicle charging bays, and 100% DG power backup.
